ACT IX OF 2013
ACT IX OF 2013
PROVINCIAL MOTOR VEHICLES
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2013
An Act further to amend the Provincial Motor
Vehicles Ordinance, 1965
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
14th March, 2013]
No.F.9(11)/2012-Legis, dated 14-3-2013.---The following Act
of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent
of the President on 11th March, 2013, is hereby published for general
information:--
WHEREAS it is expedient further to amend the
Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 (W.P. Ordinance XIX of 1965), in its
application to the Islamabad
Capital Territory,
for the purpose hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:--
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This Act may be
called the Provincial Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act, 2013.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

Amendment of section 116A, W.P. Ordinance XIX of 1965

ACT IX OF 2013
ACT IX OF 2013
PROVINCIAL MOTOR VEHICLES
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2013
An Act further to amend the Provincial Motor
Vehicles Ordinance, 1965
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
14th March, 2013]
No.F.9(11)/2012-Legis, dated 14-3-2013.---The following Act
of Majlis-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the assent
of the President on 11th March, 2013, is hereby published for general
information:--
WHEREAS it is expedient further to amend the
Provincial Motor Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 (W.P. Ordinance XIX of 1965), in its
application to the Islamabad
Capital Territory,
for the purpose hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:--
2. Amendment
of section 116A, W.P. Ordinance XIX of 1965.--In the Provincial Motor
Vehicles Ordinance, 1965 (W.P. Ordinance XIX of 1965), as in force in the
Islamabad Capital Territory, in section 116A, after subsection (5), the
following new subsection (6) shall be inserted, namely:--
"(6) The
Federal Government may, by notification in the official Gazette, amend
provisions of the Twelfth Schedule so as to add any entry thereto, modify any
entry therein or omit any entry therefrom".
